name: The Cook

gender_note.quote: The next witness was the Duchess’s cook. She carried the pepper-box in her hand

base_age_note.reason: Not stated; a seasoned, hard-handed kitchen cook.

hair.color: coarse dark red-brown, grey at the temples
hair.style: frizzing out from under a crumpled white mob cap pushed askew
hair.reason: Not described; heat and steam of the kitchen.

skin.tone: red and shiny from the fire; brawny forearms with pepper dust and soot smudges
skin.quote: the cook was leaning over the fire, stirring a large cauldron

face.default_expression: sullen and aggressive; flat refusal ('Pepper, mostly' / 'Shan’t')
face.quote: The only things in the kitchen that did not sneeze, were the cook, and a large cat

build.body_type: big, broad-shouldered and brawny; strong throwing arm
build.scale_reference: about 1.25x Alice's true size (135 cm); physically bigger than the short Duchess she serves
build.quote: at once set to work throwing everything within her reach at the Duchess and the baby
build.reason: Strength implied by the throwing; height designed.

marks.description: a large battered pepper-box, carried even into the courtroom (everyone near her sneezes)
a long ladle over a big black soup cauldron

default_outfit_tone.summary: a faded brown cotton working dress with sleeves rolled above the elbow, a large stained coarse-linen apron dusted with pepper, crumpled white mob cap
default_outfit_tone.silhouette_1862: a kitchen servant's plain full skirt without crinoline, sturdy boots
default_outfit_tone.reason: Not described; 'plain kitchen dress' per index performer_concept and FAC-duchess-household's poorer register. Costume detail by 06-art/costume.

touches: no animal coding; character-coded by pepper, the cauldron and her throwing arm
performer_coding.limits: no one is ever shown struck by what she throws (plates and pans crash around, per SUP-011/SUP-014 spirit)

prompt_base_en: a big, broad-shouldered, brawny English kitchen cook of about forty-five in 1862, frizzy dark red-brown hair greying at the temples under a crumpled askew white mob cap, narrow sullen dark eyes, broad red shiny face, rolled sleeves on strong forearms, faded brown working dress with a large pepper-dusted stained apron, holding a battered pepper-box
